# MaaJanki Web Tech
> MaaJanki Web Tech is the premier website development and digital marketing agency in Bihar, India, serving clients locally and globally (USA, UK, Canada, Australia). We specialize in high-performance web applications, local SEO, paid media, and brand identity design.

## Core Entities & Information

## Services & Expertise
- **Web Development:** High-performance, SEO-optimized, and mobile-responsive websites built using Next.js 14, React, and WordPress. Custom e-commerce storefronts (WooCommerce, Shopify) and custom billing portals.
- **Search Engine Optimization (SEO):** Technical SEO audits, local SEO, Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization, keyword mapping, and semantic link building.
- **Performance Marketing & Paid Ads:** Data-driven Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram), and PPC campaigns.
- **Social Media Optimization (SMO):** Brand promotion, account management, and audience engagement across Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn.
- **Branding & Visual Identity:** Corporate logo design, brand strategy, visual guidelines, and graphic design.
- **UI/UX Design:** User-centric wireframing, interactive prototyping, and interface design.
- **Content Writing:** SEO-optimized website copy, blogs, and product descriptions.
- **E-Commerce Product Listing:** Cataloging and product listing optimization for Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, and Shopify.

## Key Products
- **InvoBill:** A hybrid, GST-compliant billing and invoicing software designed specifically for Indian retailers and small businesses.
